invariants.claim: Successful settlement is one-time, records the proven ticket, and clears the unallocated pot.
The supplied range must inclusively contain winningEntry; terminal winningEntry is in 1..totalEntries and purchase ranges are sequential, positive, and disjoint.
NftWon allocates protocolFees + sponsorProceeds == prior unsettledPot; CashWon allocates winnerProceeds + sponsorProceeds + protocolFees == prior unsettledPot.
Reachable grossPot is positive and at most (2^128-1)*1,000,000, so both rate products fit uint256 and the sponsor remainders are nonnegative.
Settlement changes only accounting/proof storage and emits an event; it does not transfer assets, read ownership, or change status.

assumptions.claim: A terminal status is paired with a previously stored, bounded winningEntry.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.fulfillRandomWords stores winningEntry before setting NftWon or CashWon at target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L518-L523; no other status assignment creates those values at L165, L205, L252, L299, or L428.

assumptions.claim: The historical range ledger covers 1..totalEntries without gaps or overlap, and a never-minted ID has zero endpoints that cannot contain a terminal winningEntry.
assumptions.establishedBy: Positive overflow-bounded purchases assign [oldTotal+1, oldTotal+entryCount] at target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L218-L233; ticketRange reads the mapping at L451-L455; callback selection is at L518-L523.

assumptions.claim: unsettledPot equals recorded gross sales on every reachable terminal-result path.
assumptions.establishedBy: buyEntries advances entries and pot together at target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223-L233; requestDraw requires entries and leaves Active at L241-L253; refunds move the pot and select ineligible Refunding at L296-L300.

assumptions.claim: The recorded pot is backed one-for-one by quote-token custody.
assumptions.establishedBy: The transfer precedes the pot increment at target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223-L233, under the explicit canonical fee-free, non-rebasing quote-token trust model at target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L12-L15; settlement performs no balance query.

assumptions.claim: mulDiv returns floor allocations and cannot reject the reachable operands; the two rates together do not exceed the denominator.
assumptions.establishedBy: Fixed constants are at target/packages/contracts/src/libraries/RaffleConstants.sol:L11-L18; full-precision floor mulDiv and its direct low-product path are at target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol:L199-L220.

calls.propagates: Establishes only firstEntry <= winningEntry <= lastEntry, reverting otherwise; it does not establish ownership or live ERC-721 existence (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L579-L584).

Returns the two stored mapping endpoints without validation; unwritten IDs return zeros (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L451-L455; target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L368-L373).

Computes floor x*y/denominator with full precision and rejects zero denominator or an overflowing result; fixed constants and reachable bounds select a non-reverting result (target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol:L199-L277; target/packages/contracts/src/libraries/RaffleConstants.sol:L11-L18).

callers: Raffle.settleWinningTicket: unrestricted nonReentrant wrapper returning cashAmount (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L304-L306).

Raffle.redeemWinningTicket: calls only when not settled, then checks current ownership and burns/delivers; any later revert rolls back settlement in the same transaction (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L309-L345).
sharedState: status: terminal value written by fulfillRandomWords and read here; unchanged by settlement (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L509-L523, L535-L536).
winningEntry/_ticketRanges: written by callback/purchases and read through the range proof (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L226-L233, L451-L455, L518-L520, L579-L584).

unsettledPot: increased by purchases, moved by refunds or this terminal allocation, and included in accountedQuoteBalance (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223-L233, L296-L299, L539-L555, L468-L470).
settlementComplete/winningTicketId: written only here and consumed by redemption's settle-or-match branch (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L314-L318, L551-L552).
winnerProceeds: assigned on CashWon, consumed by cash redemption, and included in accounting (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L545-L549, L339-L342, L468-L470).
sponsorProceeds: assigned here, cleared by releaseSponsorProceeds, and included in accounting (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L554, L375-L381, L468-L470).
protocolFees: assigned here, cleared by releaseProtocolFees, and included in accounting (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L555, L385-L391, L468-L470).
